samples.summary: New cross-cutting storage invariant is recorded only in docs/tasks/*, not in any design doc
samples.evidence: The change establishes a model-level invariant — "a boolean inline key turned off is *cleared*, not stored as `false`, except where the block's named style supplies it truthy" — plus a new merge semantic in `block-helpers.applyInlineStyle` (a patch key set to `undefined` deletes the key). Both are consumed across packages (docs engine, slides text-box editor, `YorkieDocStore.removedInlineStyleAttrs`) and interact with the named-style lazy cascade. No `docs/design/**` file was touched by the diff; the only written record is `docs/tasks/active/20260819-docs-inline-style-off-clears-key-{todo,lessons}.md`. CONTRIBUTING.md:13-16 and :58-60 require writing/updating a design doc under `docs/design/<area>/` for a non-trivial change, folding into the canonical doc. The natural homes are `docs/design/docs/docs-font-controls.md` §"Clear formatting" (which documents the `undefined`-means-remove convention at :229-242 but says nothing about the boolean toggles) and `docs/design/docs/docs-named-styles.md` §"Cascade resolution model" (:117-131, where the false-pins-against-redefinition hazard lives).
searchedFor: Grep 'normalizeInlines|toggle-off|turning it off' in docs/design (no hits)

samples.summary: styleOffAsClear re-implements named-style default resolution instead of reusing model/caret-style.ts
samples.evidence: `styleOffAsClear` inlines `const block = this.findBlock(blockId); resolveStyleInline(blockStyleId(block), this._document.styles)` — byte-for-byte what `caretStyleDefaults(doc, position)` already does (packages/docs/src/model/caret-style.ts:31-40), a module whose own header says it exists so this walk is not "hand-copied into every editor" and whose copies previously "drifted" (issue #715). A third copy of the same resolution is exactly the drift that module was created to stop; reusing it (with `{ blockId, offset: 0 }`) or extracting a `blockStyleDefaults(doc, blockId)` helper would keep one source of truth.

samples.summary: BOOLEAN_INLINE_STYLE_KEYS is a fourth hand-maintained parallel key list; a new boolean formatting key will silently regress
samples.evidence: The repo already mandates that every new inline formatting field be added to `CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE` (model/types.ts:241) *and* both `inlineStylesEqual` sites (docs/design/slides/slides-font-ooxml-parity.md:179-180), and `removedInlineStyleAttrs` (packages/frontend/src/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.ts:144-162) enumerates the same keys again. This diff adds a fifth list with no link back to those, and nothing type-checks the set (it is a `const` array, not derived from `InlineStyle`). A future boolean toggle key omitted here reintroduces the exact #749 dead-flag bug with no failing lane; a comment cross-referencing the other lists, or deriving the set once and sharing it, would close the drift.
searchedFor: Grep for adjacent boolean-key lists (strikethrough/superscript/subscript sequences) in packages/**/src
Grep removedInlineStyleAttrs with context in yorkie-doc-store.ts

samples.summary: Only the write path is normalized; `false` flags already persisted (and any produced elsewhere) still block re-merge, and the todo does not list that as a non-goal
samples.evidence: `inlineStylesEqual` remains strict identity, so `false !== undefined` still prevents `normalizeInlines` from re-merging any run that already carries a dead flag from before this change (or from any non-toggle producer). Existing documents only heal if the user toggles the key on and off again. The task doc's Non-goals (docs/tasks/active/20260819-...-todo.md:60-66) exclude Yorkie node merging and non-boolean keys but say nothing about already-stored flags, so it is unclear whether leaving them is intended; a one-line note (or making `inlineStylesEqual` treat falsy-vs-absent as equal for booleans) would settle it.
searchedFor: Grep '(bold|italic|underline|strikethrough): false' across packages/*/src (only notes toolbar + harness fixtures)

verdict.reason: The absence claim holds up on the facts: I searched all of docs/design/ (112 files) for applyInlineStyle, removedInlineStyleAttrs, InlineStyle, undefined, `false`, demote, dead flag, clear the key, toggle, add-vs-remove, isStyleOn, and found no design doc recording the new rule that a boolean inline key turned off is cleared rather than stored as `false` (with the named-style-truthy exception), nor the `undefined`-deletes-key merge semantic. The closest existing text is docs-font-controls.md:239-242 (CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE / `undefined`-removes-attribute convention) and :373-377 plus docs-named-styles.md:117-131 (lazy cascade), none of which cover the boolean toggle-off rule; the only written record is code comments (document.ts:382-418, block-helpers.ts:306-325) and docs/tasks/active/20260819-...-todo.md:29-58. What I could not settle is whether a design doc is REQUIRED for this change: CONTRIBUTING.md:11-12 gives bug fixes an explicit design-doc-free lane and CLAUDE.md:56-63 reserves docs/design for architecture changes while assigning non-trivial tasks to docs/tasks pairs — and this is a localized bug fix (one private Doc helper + one merge helper, no type/API/module change) leaning on an already-documented convention. Against that, CONTRIBUTING.md:57-61 asks that an evolving area's canonical doc be updated, and the sibling #715 fix did fold its narrative into docs-font-controls.md. Since I found no counterexample and cannot confidently declare the doc requirement inapplicable, I leave the finding on the gate rather than refute it.
